title: M mute key is dead end-to-end — no device-event→intent mapping exists for Toggle_Mute
evidence: app/input/poll.odin:60: `if rl.IsKeyPressed(.M) { append(&inp.events, Device_Event(Key_Press{key = .M})) }` — but mouse_map's two translation switches have no .M case: app/input/mouse.odin:90 `case: // R/Enter map via the Game_Over early return; phase-2 keys below` (phase-1 switch at :79 handles only .P,.Space,.D,.T,.Esc) and app/input/mouse.odin:343 `case: // phase-1 keys already handled` (phase-2 switch at :315 handles only .X,.Delete,.U,.One,.Two,.E,.S,.B). app/input/exec.odin:44-46 `case Toggle_Mute:` / `if inp.on_mute != nil { inp.on_mute(inp.user, inp) }`. grep Toggle_Mute across all .odin: only app/input/types.odin:147 `Toggle_Mute :: struct {}`, app/input/types.odin:277 (Intent union member), app/input/exec.odin:44 — no site constructs `Intent(Toggle_Mute{})`. app/main.odin:269 `app.input.on_mute = effect_mute`, :655-657 `effect_mute :: proc(...)` / `au.toggle_mute(&app.audio)`. README.md:24 "`M` mutes/unmutes audio (7.2; captions stay on while muted — every audio".
detail: poll emits Key_Press{.M}, but both #partial key switches drop it, so no Toggle_Mute intent is ever produced. effect_mute/toggle_mute and the "audio muted - press M" caption are unreachable; the README/PR-body M-mute claim is false in the built game.
recommended_fix: In mouse_map, map the key: add `case .M: append(out, Intent(Toggle_Mute{}))` to the phase-2 switch (mouse.odin:315), or collect .M with the phase-1 keys after growing `keys: [4]Key` to `[5]`.

title: assets/audio/README.md names Suno and omits the terms notes the PR body claims it carries
evidence: assets/audio/README.md:34-35: "1. Generate in Suno (paid tier — commercial rights, owned outright) or your / editor of choice." — grep for elevenlabs/sublicens/terms in the file: zero hits. PR body (spec/pr-body.md): "Terms notes carried in `assets/audio/README.md`: (a) paid-plan ElevenLabs outputs are assigned to the user with **perpetual commercial rights, surviving subscription end**; (b) ElevenLabs SFX outputs are **sublicensed to other ElevenLabs users BY DEFAULT**" and "SFX — the two stings in this contract — come from **ElevenLabs**".
detail: The PR body claims the README carries the ElevenLabs terms notes; the actual README names Suno as the generator and carries none. The in-repo drop-in contract points users at the wrong source and omits the required sublicensing opt-out note.
recommended_fix: Update assets/audio/README.md: name ElevenLabs for SFX (Suno/ElevenLabs Music for ambience only if ever needed) and add the three terms notes from the PR body.
